title: The Morning Circuit — Tuesday, June 09, 2026
description: Top stories: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is getting a remake for the Switch 2; Apple brings streaming-style subscription bundles to the App Store; Pokémon Pokopia is getting underwater mechanics and a bunch of paid DLC; Switch 2 exclusive Orbitals arrives September 3; Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave hits Switch 2 on September 17.
